maintainer_access: maintainer can administer; required checks still apply to pushes
notes: This file documents the desired protection for the public main branch; actual organization and classic settings are reconciled independently.

Every required name is an observed current GitHub Actions check (App 15368), including native CLI/syntax, both CodeQL languages, dependency review, all three platform lanes and the source/security jobs.

Mandatory merge stops retain the original pull-request commit-range secret gate; default/manual source verify retains complete-history scanning. Neither replaces native CLI/syntax, CodeQL, dependency review or platform checks.
pytest (ubuntu-26.04 / py3.13) remains required when its workflow paths are eligible, but is excluded from the unconditional branch floor because its workflow is path-filtered.
Scorecard, security-daily, CLI/dependency drift and release are push-only, scheduled, manual or operator workflows; they cannot be unconditional pull-request requirements.
Linear history remains off because verified changes use merge commits. No force pushes or branch deletion.
Approvals remain zero and code-owner review off for the existing single-maintainer contract; existing administrative settings are unchanged.
